messages:
Anna (sec-eng): Heads up — incoming external assessment (third-party) next Tue-Thu. Need to confirm access windows for KMS, RBAC exceptions, and audit log extraction plan.
Dylan (infra): 👍 Can we keep access window to 20 min per assessor? That worked last time.
Maya (platform): We need to run KMS proxy for encrypted key material — recommend ephemeral GRPC proxy with short TTL. Also, what IAM roles do they need? read-only vs decrypt?
Anna (sec-eng): Assessors need decrypt for test scopes, limited to staging and AV environment only. No production data. We'll grant iam:Decrypt for kms:*/staging-* keys.
Oliver (sre): For audit logs, export 90d of cloudtrail & syslogs to secure bucket. Will that satisfy auditors?
Ben (product): Product signoff: confirm no customer PII in staging. We've scrubbed dataset A. @anna pls confirm.
Anna (sec-eng): Confirmed no PII. Also need RBAC temporary allowlist for a set of accounts — prefer short-lived group change over per-user ACL. Draft below:
Anna (sec-eng): ```
# temp group creation
gcloud iam groups create groups/assessors-2026-04
# bind to roles
gcloud projects add-iam-policy-binding redwood-staging \n  --member=group:assessors-2026-04@redwood.com \n  --role=roles/kms.cryptoOperator
# TTL: 24h
```
Dylan (infra): We'll use SCIM to add assessors then remove automatically after 48h. Need list of emails by Friday EOD.
Maya (platform): KMS proxy: we'll open port via bastion and record pcap for the window. Also will produce a snapshot of key metadata (key ids, versions).
PentestBot: Assessment intake created: https://redwood.tools/pentest/INTAKE-588 — added checklist and evidence bucket.
Anna (sec-eng): Action items: 1) @ben confirm scrubbed dataset (by Fri) 2) @dylan provide emails + ephemeral creds plan (by Mon) 3) @maya share KMS proxy config and retention policy (by Mon) 4) @oliver confirm log export path and retention (by Mon)
Ben (product): I'm on it.
Dylan (infra): I'll compile emails and the SCIM add/remove playbook.
Maya (platform): Draft config attached in repo: infra/assessments/kms-proxy-config.yaml (will DM link) — TTL default 1h for keys.
Oliver (sre): I'll schedule log export job and add a webhook to push alerts to #incidents if any high-sev findings during assessment.
Anna (sec-eng): Great. Plan for retest: if findings > sev2, we'll schedule retest window within 10 business days. Otherwise standard recheck at 30 days. Keep communication here. :white_check_mark:
Ben (product): Any guidance for assessors around incident reporting for live exploits during test?
Anna (sec-eng): If they trigger a live exploit, treat as incident: isolate, revoke assessors' access, notify sec oncall, and capture forensic logs. We'll run tabletop on first day. I'll add to the intake doc.
Dylan (infra): One last thing — auditors requested KMS key rotation history. @maya can we export rotation events?
Maya (platform): Yep — will export KMS Audit log filter: resource.type="kms_key" protoPayload.methodName:"kms.keys.update"; push to evidence bucket.
Anna (sec-eng): Thanks all — please update the intake ticket when items are done. I'll close this thread after Friday check-in.
